name: Medallion Credentialing
description: Medallion is an AI-powered healthcare credentialing and provider network management platform that automates provider enrollment, license verification, and payer contracting. The platform uses intelligent automation to reduce credentialing timelines from months to weeks while maintaining compliance with NCQA standards.

core_features.name: Automated Provider Credentialing
core_features.description: AI-powered primary source verification that automates credential checks across 1,000+ sources including state medical boards, DEA, NPI, and specialty boards

core_features.name: Payer Enrollment Automation
core_features.description: Streamlined enrollment with 500+ commercial and government payers including Medicare, Medicaid, and major commercial insurers

core_features.name: CAQH ProView Management
core_features.description: Automated CAQH profile creation, updates, and re-attestation management

core_features.name: License Monitoring
core_features.description: Real-time monitoring of license expirations, sanctions, and disciplinary actions with automated alerts

core_features.name: Privileging Workflows
core_features.description: Configurable privileging workflows for hospital and health system credentialing committees

core_features.name: Provider Dashboard
core_features.description: Self-service portal for providers to submit documents, track application status, and manage credentials

pricing.notes: Volume discounts available for 100+ providers. Enterprise contracts typically 12-24 months.

best_for: Growing telehealth companies scaling provider networks
not_ideal_for: Practices seeking basic license tracking only

faqs.question: How long does credentialing take with Medallion?
faqs.answer: Medallion typically reduces credentialing timelines from 90-120 days to 30-45 days through automated primary source verification and intelligent workflow management. Payer enrollment timelines vary by insurance company but are generally reduced by 40-60%.

faqs.question: Does Medallion handle payer enrollment for mental health providers?
faqs.answer: Yes, Medallion supports payer enrollment with 500+ commercial and government payers including major behavioral health networks. They handle Medicare, Medicaid, and specialty panels relevant to psychiatrists, psychologists, and therapists.

faqs.question: What is Medallion's accuracy rate for credential verification?
faqs.answer: Medallion reports 99.5%+ accuracy in primary source verification through their AI-powered verification engine. They verify against over 1,000 data sources including state licensing boards, DEA, specialty certifications, and sanctions databases.

faqs.question: Can Medallion help with multi-state licensure for telehealth?
faqs.answer: Yes, Medallion supports multi-state license tracking and can coordinate applications for Psychology Interjurisdictional Compact (PSYPACT) and Counseling Compact states. They provide automated monitoring for license renewals across all states.
